title: Release
description: Displays the site's build/release number, read from the one version stamp instead of a hardcoded literal.

format.description: Template for the badge text, with `{version}` replaced. Defaults to `v{version}`.

reload.description: Clear caches and reload when the badge is activated. On unless set to `"false"`.
